name: Split World
tagline: Charades inside Snapchat: act a word as a stick figure and your friend guesses.

awards: Best use of Snap Lens Studio

problem: The team wanted a fast, shareable social game.
solution: A Lens Studio lens records the hinter as a body-tracked stick figure; the other player guesses from the clip.
demo_moment: Team-described: act out a word and send it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Snap Lens Studio” among 212 submissions.
Built for sharing within the platform.

lessons: Design the game around the share.
